# 调整杠杆设置 (TRADE)

- **POST** `/capi/v3/account/leverage`

权重(IP): 10

**请求参数**

| 参数名 | 类型 | 是否必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| symbol | String | 是 | 交易对 |
| marginType | String | 否 | 目标保证金模式。可选值：CROSSED（全仓）、ISOLATED（逐仓）。 |
| crossLeverage | String | 否 | 全仓杠杆，当 marginType 为 CROSSED 时应填写。 |
| isolatedLongLeverage | String | 否 | 逐仓多单杠杆，需要调整逐仓多头时填写。 |
| isolatedShortLeverage | String | 否 | 逐仓空单杠杆，需要调整逐仓空头时填写。 |

`crossLeverage`、`isolatedLongLeverage`、`isolatedShortLeverage` 至少需要填写其中一项。

**请求示例**

```
curl -X POST "https://api-contract.weex.com/capi/v3/account/leverage" \
   -H "ACCESS-KEY:*******" \
   -H "ACCESS-SIGN:*******" \
   -H "ACCESS-PASSPHRASE:*****" \
   -H "ACCESS-TIMESTAMP:1659076670000" \
   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
   -d '{"symbol":"BTCUSDT","marginType":"ISOLATED","isolatedLongLeverage":"20","isolatedShortLeverage":"20"}'
```

**返回参数**

| 参数名 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| symbol | String | 交易对 |
| marginType | String | 生效的保证金模式 |
| crossLeverage | String | 当前全仓杠杆 |
| isolatedLongLeverage | String | 当前逐仓多单杠杆 |
| isolatedShortLeverage | String | 当前逐仓空单杠杆 |

**返回示例**

```
{
  "symbol": "BTCUSDT",
  "marginType": "ISOLATED",
  "crossLeverage": "0",
  "isolatedLongLeverage": "20",
  "isolatedShortLeverage": "20"
}
```
